steps.text: Go to polymarket.com and click Sign Up in the top right corner
Create account with email and password, or connect wallet (MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, etc.)

Place a trade using your credit — buy shares in an outcome you believe will happen
If your prediction is correct, shares settle at $1 each — withdraw realized gains to your bank or crypto wallet

Use the bonus credit to trade additional event contracts before expiry
Withdraw any realized gains to your linked bank account

Buy Yes or No shares in a market at 1c-99c per share, within the per-market position cap.

Wait for email/text invitations for tests or interviews that match your profile.
Fill out the brief screener on each invitation to confirm you are the right fit.
Complete the test (1-5 minutes, $0.20/min) or attend the interview via Zoom/Google Meet ($0.75+/min) with camera and microphone.
Your UserCrowd account is credited with the incentive once the session concludes successfully.

Complete your profile fully and honestly — this is how you get matched to studies
Verify email, phone, and ID as required by the platform
Connect your PayPal account (most platforms pay via PayPal)

Sign up at https://www.playtestcloud.com/ (become a playtester) — free.
Complete the short, unpaid Playtester Onboarding test to prove your commentary quality and device capability.
Wait for the review result (typically a couple of days); if you don't pass, you get feedback and can retry.
Accept playtest invitations by email — each invitation states the exact reward before you start.
Play the game while continuously talking through your thoughts aloud, complete all in-game tasks, then complete the post-test survey in detail.
Get paid $5–$9 per 15-minute playtest (reward shown in the invite); no minimum threshold to redeem.

Complete your profile so you can be matched to missions.

Review the detailed preview: tasks, time estimate, and compensation shown before you commit.
Complete the mission (diary entries, video responses, photos) to a high standard — low-effort responses can be rejected.
Get paid via PayPal after the mission is reviewed and approved.

Go to the official creator page https://JoinBrands.com/creator/ and click 'Get started - it's free' to create a creator account (you must be 18+ and in the USA, UK, Germany, Australia, or Canada).
Connect your social accounts (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Amazon — a plus for extra earning) and complete your creator profile.
Browse the job marketplace — every job shows the pay, product value, and commission upfront before you apply.
Apply to jobs that fit your content; the brand selects the creator.
If selected, receive or buy (reimbursed) the product and create the content per the brief.
Submit for approval — once approved, the payout is added to your virtual wallet, then transfer to PayPal. Expect 15-20% platform fee deducted.
Apply to become a Billo creator via the official site and pass their creator vetting (5,000+ vetted creators; acceptance is not automatic).

steps.text: Add your PayPal account details to your creator profile — payouts only go to PayPal.
Browse available tasks: each task shows its set, non-negotiable payout before you apply.
Apply to a task and, once approved, receive the product/brief.
Create and upload the video within the 5-day deadline (missing it hurts your On-Time score; repeated misses can get you suspended).
The brand has 3 business days to review; if they take no action the video auto-approves.
Receive payment: approved videos are paid out twice a month via PayPal (arrives same day or within 1-2 workdays).
Join Influee as a creator (free for creators, no subscription) and build your portfolio.
Browse brand campaigns on the marketplace — note the per-video budget shown on each campaign.
Apply to campaigns in your niche; brands select the creators.
Create the content per the brief (unlimited revisions are included on the platform).

Deliver and get paid per campaign — the per-video price starts around $20 on the brand side; your take-home is net of Influee's platform commission (their pages cite both 10% and 20% — confirm your actual rate in your creator agreement).
Note: full content rights transfer to the brand by default.
Go to https://insense.pro or download the Insense app
Create a creator profile with truthful personal and payout information
Upload a short sample video of a product you own (30-60 seconds)
Filter campaigns for disclosed cash payment and no required product purchase
Read the campaign brief: content rights, payment amount, delivery date, revision rules, platform fee
Apply only to campaigns matching your device, format, location, and availability
If accepted: follow the brand brief shot-by-shot — hook, product, use case, proof, call to action
Edit the video: add captions, trim to length, ensure good lighting and audio
Submit through the platform and make revisions if requested
Get paid after approval (net of platform fees)
Screenshot the payment and log in Proof Log
Build a portfolio of approved videos to increase acceptance rate for future campaigns

Apply to the Amazon Influencer Program online at https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/influencers using a qualifying TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, or Facebook account.
Once approved, build your personalized Amazon storefront (amazon.com/shop/yourhandle) and organize recommendations into themed Idea Lists.
Add products to your storefront via search or direct ASIN entry; create shoppable photos and videos, which are eligible to appear across Amazon's product detail pages, search results, and homepage.
Share your storefront URL and personalized referral links with your followers on social media.
Earn a standard commission on qualifying purchases made through your storefront, links, or shoppable content — commissions are not limited to the specific product you recommended.
Optionally use Creator Connections to pitch for brand collaborations (bonus commissions, traffic payments, or flat-rate sponsored content fees) — brand-selected, not guaranteed.
Creator Rewards can add a monthly bonus on top of standard commissions when you hit certain sales targets.
Create a ShopMy creator account and complete the creator setup.
Add products to your account — ShopMy automatically converts them into ShopMy affiliate links via its integrations with retailer and brand affiliate programs.
Share your ShopMy affiliate links with your audience (social, blog, newsletter).
When a purchase is made, the commission enters Pending status while the retailer closes its return window, verifies the transaction, and pays ShopMy.
Once ShopMy receives the funds, your commission moves to Locked (typically 30–120 days after purchase).
Track your payment history under the 'My Earnings' tab in the Payments section.
Receive a single streamlined payment via Stripe or PayPal every Friday, once you have at least $11 under 'Next Payment.'
Sign up as a creator on Mavely (joinmavely.com) and verify your account — no fee or application, and no minimum following required.
Create shoppable SmartLinks for products from participating brands and share them on your social accounts, blog, newsletter, or link-in-bio.
When your audience shops through your links, you earn the brand's commission rate in full — what you see on Mavely's rate cards is what lands in your wallet.
Pursue brand campaigns and referral commission as additional earning paths listed in Mavely's official FAQ.
Track your monthly commissions on the Live Bonus Tracker in the Mavely app or desktop dashboard.

If your monthly commissions hit a bonus tier ($17,000 / $27,000 / $42,500), the corresponding bonus ($4,000 / $6,000 / $10,000) is paid automatically — no opt-in needed — 30 days after the end of that calendar month.

File the complaint online (or by printable form) with copies — never originals — of contracts, receipts, and correspondence; note the resolution you want (refund, product delivery, service performed).
The AG's office may forward your complaint to the business for mediation, or use it as evidence in an enforcement action.

Watch for multistate settlements in your state: if one covers you, the claims administrator notifies you directly and you file with them — e.g., the Sept 2026 $694M Credit Acceptance settlement across 40+ states.

When a Notice of Proposed Plan of Distribution is published for a case you may fit, get the plan from sec.gov (or by written request to the named SEC contact).
Read the plan's eligibility (relevant period, recognized loss methodology) — if you do not fit, stop.
File your claim with the appointed Fund Administrator before the plan's claims bar date, with trade documentation; denied claims get a chance to cure.

steps.text: Be a California resident, 18 years old on or before Election Day (students 16+ have additional requirements).

Work Election Day, generally 6 AM to 8:30 PM; Judge of Election picks up and delivers election materials.

Offer: Serve as a Precinct Election Official (PEO) for Clermont County, OH Board of Elections on Election Day.
Requirements: Be a properly registered voter of Clermont County; must attend training class and have transportation to the polls on Election Day morning.
Time required: At the polls no later than 5:45 a.m. on Election Day; polls open 6:30 a.m. and close 7:30 p.m.; finished about 8:00 p.m. or possibly later. Approximately 14+ hours.
Offer: Serve as a Precinct Election Official (PEO) for Linn County, IA on Election Day.
Requirements: Live in and be registered to vote in Linn County, Iowa; be able to work from 6 a.m. until close of polls; attend the required training classes.

Time required: Work from 6 a.m. until close of polls (polls open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.); close the polling place at 8 p.m. and complete closing requirements. Roughly 14-16 hours on Election Day plus training.
Offer: Serve as a poll worker for the Boone County Clerk in Kentucky on Election Day.
Requirements: Must be a US citizen; 18 years old by the General Election; registered Boone County voter; attend mandatory training classes.
Time required: Election Day 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. (12 hours) plus a mandatory training class.
Be a US citizen and registered voter of Onslow County; of good repute and able to read and write; not hold elective office, candidacy, or party/treasurer offices.

steps.text: You both get a $40 credit on your next monthly statements
steps.done_when: The reward has arrived for both of you.

steps.text: Apply for the Amazon Store Card on amazon.com (requires an Amazon.com account) and receive Synchrony Bank credit approval.
On approval, the $80 Amazon Gift Card is automatically and instantly loaded into your Amazon wallet.
Use the gift-card balance toward a future Amazon purchase you already planned.
Pay any card balance in full by the due date so the 29.99% APR never applies.
steps.done_when: The balance is paid in full.

steps.text: Apply for a new JCPenney Credit Card or JCPenney Mastercard on jcpcreditcard.com and receive credit approval.
A $10 CashPass Reward Certificate is deposited into your JCPenney Rewards account within 48 hours of opening — use it on eligible JCPenney purchases.
Optionally, use the new card for a single qualifying purchase by 11/30/2026 to redeem the account-opening coupon: $35 off a $35-$499.99 purchase or $125 off a $500+ purchase (in-store or jcp.com).
Pay the statement balance in full by the due date so the 33.24% APR never applies.
steps.done_when: The balance is paid in full.

steps.text: Apply for a new Belk Rewards+ credit card (store card or Mastercard) and receive credit approval.
Make any purchase with the new card the day the account is opened.
The $10 Bonus Belk Reward Dollars (1,000 bonus points) are issued to your Belk Rewards+ account within 10 days; redeem toward a Belk purchase within 60 days.
Pay the statement balance in full by the due date so the 34.99% APR never applies.
steps.done_when: The balance is paid in full.

steps.text: Join Journeys All Access for free on journeys.com (create an account) or in-store.
Receive the $10-off welcome perk for new members.
Apply it to a first order of $75 or more (plus free shipping as a member).
Enroll with first name, last name and email address on the official Zales signup page.
Receive the $50-off code by email.
Apply it to an online order of $300 or more within 30 days of receiving the email.
Submit the official Lamps Plus New Homeowner signup form (first name, last name, email, zip).
Receive the $15-off coupon.
Apply it to an order of $50 or more, online or in store.
Enable Hibbett Mobile Alerts (sign up for SMS alerts) on hibbett.com.
Receive the $10-off coupon at signup.
Apply it to an order of $50 or more.
Open an Indiana529 account online (minimum $10 to start).
steps.done_when: The account is open in your name.

steps.text: Contribute to the account during the calendar tax year.
Claim the 20% credit on your Indiana state income tax return (up to $1,500 per year; $750 if married filing separately).
Keep the funds for qualified education expenses to avoid credit recapture.
Open a Quest529 account at Quest529.com if you do not already have one.
steps.done_when: The account is open in your name.

steps.text: Complete the 2026 KIDS Program Application.
Attach 2025 federal tax returns or IRS transcripts for all household members required to file.
Mail the application and documents so they are received by the Kansas State Treasurer's Office no later than December 1, 2026 (supporting documents within 14 days of application).
steps.done_when: It's in the mail to you.

steps.text: Contribute $100-$600 to the KIDS Contribution Account during calendar 2026.
The matching grant is deposited to the Match Account no later than January 31, 2027.
Check eligibility at Treasury.TN.gov/TIPS (Tennessee resident, child 14 or younger, household income limits).
Complete the TIPS Program Application during the qualifying period (applications accepted through June 30, 2026).
Once approved, open a TNStars account for each child (as little as $25 to start).
steps.done_when: The account is open in your name.

steps.text: Deposit to the TNStars account by June 30 of the qualifying period; the state matches $4 for every $1 deposited.
Confirm the child's eligibility (Texas Tuition Promise Fund beneficiary, grades 3-9, Texas resident, family income $120,000 or less).
Read the Matching Scholarship and Tuition Grant Description and Application Instructions.
Have the child research a career and write the student career essay; obtain the prior school year's report card or transcript.
steps.done_when: You've got the Prior School Year.

steps.text: Apply online at MatchThePromise.org (or by mail) between September 1 and December 31.
If approved, submit the federal tax return for income verification by May 31 and ensure at least $50 in contributions to the Promise Fund contract during the sales period (Sept 1-Aug 31).
Open a new NJBEST 529 account (as little as $25) for a new student beneficiary.
steps.done_when: The account is open in your name.

steps.text: Make the initial deposit (matched dollar-for-dollar up to $750).
Submit the NJBEST Matching Grant application within one year of funding, attaching prior-year IRS tax return transcripts (or documented proof of income).
Keep the account open and maintain up to $750 of the initial contribution for at least three years.
steps.done_when: The account stays open and in good standing.

steps.text: Check the CollegeBoundbaby box on the hospital birth worksheet, OR self-enroll by submitting the CollegeBoundbaby Authorization Form within one year of the child's birth or adoption.
The $100 grant is deposited into the child's CollegeBound account.
When the child enrolls in college, funds are disbursed by the RI Treasurer directly to the eligible school.
